protocol.scaling: None; original accelerometer numeric amplitude, physical unit not asserted by this importer.
protocol.grouping: Assign whole source MAT recording to one split before filtering/windowing; discard filter edges and incomplete trailing windows. No adjacent/overlapping windows from the same recording enter different splits.
protocol.fit: Healthy A-1 and B-1; increasing and decreasing speed.
protocol.calibration: Healthy A-2 and B-2; separate trials.
protocol.validation: A-3 healthy, inner and outer fault recordings; selection only.
protocol.test: C-3 healthy, inner and outer fault recordings; increasing-then-decreasing profile C held out from fit/calibration/selection.
limits: Controlled lab faults, not in-service industrial fault prevalence.
Only ten recordings; windows within a recording are correlated, not independent replicates.

No physical bearing serial IDs are supplied; recording separation is not bearing/device-disjoint validation. Bearing identity and health may be confounded; no cross-device generalization claim is permitted.
Only vibration samples enter the model, not filename, condition, trial, encoder or device metadata.
1.2 kHz low-pass discards higher-frequency fault information; this fixed CPU prototype protocol is not a full-band fault diagnostic.
